northzone._readme: Durable identity corrections consumed by build-company-base.py on every rebuild (COLLECTION.md s8): one company under different names across Northzone's surfaces (the live list, the archived listings 2003-2025, Form D issuer names) and its renames. Canonical = the firm's current rendering where the company is still listed. Written during the grind (PRO-105, 2026-09-29) and applied at the one scheduled rebuild. Archive renames added 2026-09-29 from the Common Crawl captures of 2010-2025.

merges.name: Dots
merges.reason: one company: Playdots, Inc. (New York) is the legal name of Dots, the live list's entry (dots.co); its 2014 Form D carries Paul Murphy as Executive Officer, the founder-era filing (decisions.md D9); the 2013-14 pages render it as 'Playdots'
